# 今日は犬の日なのでｺﾚ
肉球ポテトサラダ

## 材料
じゃがいも2個、きゅうり1/2本、ハム2枚、マヨネーズ大さじ3、塩胡椒少々。飾り用にカニカマ、黒ゴマ少量。

## 作り方
じゃがいもは茹でて潰し、きゅうり・ハムは細かく切る。マヨネーズと塩胡椒で混ぜる。ラップで丸く成形し、小さな丸を4つ作り肉球の形に。カニカマと黒ゴマで飾る。

## イメージしたポイント
犬の肉球を再現し、思わず笑顔になる可愛さ。犬の日を楽しく祝うメニューです。

images.alt:
JK Dark Summoner to Deki......Dei Nai!? Anime Overview:

JK Dark Summoner to Deki......Dei Nai!? is a comedic mini anime that serves as a short companion piece to the main broadcast of Dark Summoner to Dekiteiru. The series centers around a high school girl who unexpectedly gains the ability to summon dark entities, blending supernatural summoning elements with everyday school life comedy. Episodes focus on the humorous daily complications and awkward situations that arise as the protagonist attempts to balance her ordinary teenage responsibilities with her strange newfound occult powers. Designed as brief comedic vignettes, the shorts air alongside the primary television broadcast and streaming releases to provide lighthearted supplementary content for fans of the franchise.

Japanese Title: JKダークサモナーとデキ。。。。。。でいない!?
